title: MIR 3.2.5 compatibility observability and convergence
migration_impact: Combines the unreleased C31 research-cost work with derived compatibility dispositions, proof assertions, bounded support reporting, profile hardening, and behavior-preserving compiler consolidation. The public upgrade starts at 3.2.3; stable IDs and neutral defaults are preserved.
release_note_impact: One consolidated 3.2.5 release note and migration guide replace the unpublished 3.2.4 release plan.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: canonical implementation and one public release on dev/main as MIR 3.2.5
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: continuously project through target adapters and release as MIR 2.5.5 only after exact reconstruction and independent target qualification

terminal_disposition: Implemented and published in the immutable 3.2.5 and 2.5.5 wave; later corrections are owned by CHG-2026-0020.
